hazards.evidence: Cups, containers, and other kitchen items are stored on high open shelves, requiring overhead reaching.
Baskets and kitchen items are stored in low open cubbies, requiring bending or crouching.
An open folding step stool is positioned in the kitchen for reaching elevated storage.
A long cord runs and loops across the floor in the main walking area.
The central walker route is obstructed by a step stool, pet bed, bowls, toys, and a cord.
The kitchen and floor-level obstacles are poorly illuminated overall.
A pet bed, feeding bowls, and multiple pet toys are spread across the central floor and are underfoot.
